task:
Practice kubectl output formatting — these appear as short questions on the real exam.

Complete each of the following:

  1. Get the names and namespaces of all pods, sorted by namespace:
     kubectl get pods --all-namespaces --sort-by=.metadata.namespace

  2. List all pods with custom columns showing NAME, NAMESPACE, NODE, and STATUS:
     kubectl get pods -A -o custom-columns='NAME:.metadata.name,NAMESPACE:.metadata.namespace,NODE:.spec.nodeName,STATUS:.status.phase'

  3. Get only the image of the first container of all pods in kube-system:
     kubectl get pods -n kube-system -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name}{"\t"}{.spec.containers[0].image}{"\n"}{end}'

  4. Sort nodes by their creation timestamp:
     kubectl get nodes --sort-by=.metadata.creationTimestamp

  5. Write the output of (4) to a file:
     kubectl get nodes --sort-by=.metadata.creationTimestamp > /var/tmp/nodes-sorted.txt

Save the file from step 5 — it will be validated.

validators.description: kube-system pods can be listed with jsonpath
